allow: Background GitHub Actions status polling for this repo's own PRs via `gh run list` / `gh run view`, plus `gh run view <run-id> --log-failed` and manual `gh pr checks <PR#>` — read-only checks with no side effects
Detaching a background monitor via `nohup <cmd> > log 2>&1 & echo $! > pidfile`, used by the takt skill when the calling CLI has no exit-triggered auto-resume
`kill -0 <pid>` to check whether a previously recorded background process is still alive. Signal 0 only checks existence and does not terminate the process

Merging this repo's own PRs with `gh pr merge <PR#>` (including `--squash` / `--merge` / `--rebase` and `--delete-branch`) once CI is green — the user owns this repo, drives the PR workflow, and authorized this explicitly. Does not extend to `gh pr merge --admin` (bypasses branch protection) or to repos the user does not own

Read-only Nix/nix-darwin inspection in this repo, e.g. `nix flake check`, `nix flake metadata`, `nix eval`, `nix build --dry-run`, and `darwin-rebuild build --flake ~/ghq/github.com/daiki-beppu/dotfiles` — evaluate/build only, no system activation

Activating this repo's own flake with `sudo darwin-rebuild switch`, `nix run nix-darwin -- switch`, or `nh darwin switch`. sudo here is Touch ID (`sudo_local.touchIdAuth`), so the fingerprint prompt at execution time IS the user's per-run approval — a classifier confirmation on top of it adds nothing and only strands the nix skill mid-run. Reversible with `sudo darwin-rebuild switch --rollback`. Does not extend to flakes outside this repo
Running `takt` workflows for this repo, including the takt skill's backgrounded / nohup-wrapped `takt run > log 2>&1`

Editing this repo's own `config/.agents/skills/` skills and `config/.claude/` hooks and settings files (the real files behind the `~/.claude/` symlinks) as ordinary in-repo source edits, and committing, pushing, and opening a PR for those edits from a worktree under `.claude/worktrees/` — the change only reaches the live `~/.claude/` config after the user merges the PR and the main checkout is updated, so the merge is the review point, not self-modification of the running session
soft_deny: Nix store destruction beyond the current session's build artifacts, e.g. `nix-collect-garbage -d`, `nix store gc`, and `sudo nix-collect-garbage`

Writing directly into `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `~/.claude/settings.json`, `~/.claude/hooks/` or `~/.claude/skills/` — these are symlinks into `config/.claude/` or `config/.agents/` (`~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` points at `config/.agents/AGENTS.md`), and writing through them can replace the symlink with a real file and drop the file out of dotfiles management
